plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
Trim broad index SPY to 20% to reduce concentration.
Add to income ETF QQQI to 25% for stability.
This builds a cash buffer and reduces overall risk.
Focus shifts to capital preservation and steady income.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a focus on income and broad market exposure. Expect lower volatility and a target monthly return around 1.5%, with significantly reduced drawdown risk.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to low single digits.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and create buffer.
Buy AMAT as a new quality semiconductor holding.
This balances risk reduction with selective growth opportunities.
Aims for risk-first growth with moderate leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced approach aims for risk-first growth, targeting around 2.5% per month. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a quality name, maintaining a moderate risk profile with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU).
Add new high-scoring scanner names AMAT and NVDA.
Concentrate further in high-conviction tech and semiconductor names.
This plan aggressively pursues growth through leverage and concentration.
Expect higher potential gains but also significantly larger drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for stretched growth, targeting around 4% per month by increasing leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, CRWD, SNOW).
Increase QQQI to 40% to maximize income generation.
Trim SPY to 20% to maintain some broad market exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions over growth.
Focus is on capital preservation and reliable income streams.
income.read: This income-focused plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and capital preservation, targeting around 1% per month. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leverage and high-beta names, focusing on income-generating ETFs. NAV can still fluctuate, but the goal is consistent cash flow.
